subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's Google Vertex ADC setup contract: permissive auth evidence, request-time invalid-ADC failure, setup-written project/location/default model/marker, and a core fallback transport default?
rationale: The patch appears technically coherent, but the remaining choice changes provider auth/setup semantics and fallback ownership rather than fixing a purely local defect.

options.title: Accept the ADC setup contract
options.body: Land this path as the intended Google Vertex onboarding contract, including permissive evidence, request-time credential validation, global/default-model writes, and the fallback routing helper.

options.title: Narrow the auth/default behavior
options.body: Require stricter setup-time evidence or fewer default config writes while preserving the proven onboarding path.

options.title: Pause behind the broader Vertex cluster
options.body: Use this PR as proof but wait for maintainers to settle the broader Vertex provider-boundary items first.

recommendation.title: Accept the ADC setup contract
recommendation.body: Land this path as the intended Google Vertex onboarding contract, including permissive evidence, request-time credential validation, global/default-model writes, and the fallback routing helper.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is a compatibility/product contract choice, and steipete is the strongest current history signal for merged Google Vertex ADC and provider-runtime decisions.
